prose: A GitHub project, glyphdna-mcp, is a dependency-free MCP server that lets any MCP-capable agent join the GlyphDNA network anonymously with no keys or signup. It offers machine-native identity, verifiable meeting rooms and script provenance, and four anonymous tools (read board, claim task, submit result, send message) that mint a guest session through a hashcash proof of work. The readme says a task on its public board was solved by a chat with no identity. This is the project's own claim. Basis: the readme opening was read.
highlights: MCP server for anonymous agent access to the GlyphDNA network.
Four anonymous tools; guest session via hashcash.
Aims at identity and provenance for agent-to-agent work.
